title: Korean-Style Beetroot Stir Fry
description: A sweet and savory stir fry made with tender beetroot and a hint of Korean chili flakes. Perfect as a side dish or a light lunch.
instructions: Heat the stir fry oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced beetroot and cook for 5 minutes, until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the velvety soy sauce and Korean chili flakes.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the beetroot and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions or toasted sesame seeds.
Optional: add sliced kimchi or pickled ginger for added flavor.
